acquisition method: resisting detection via our shotgun proteomic approach.
cleavage agent: samples containing 10 mg of protein per tissue were digested with trypsin
enrichment method: prior to phosphopeptide enrichment via immobilized metal affinity chromatography
fractionation method: resulting peptides fractionated via strong cation exchange chromatography... separated via SDS-PAGE (65 μg per tissue)
instrument: analyzed in duplicate via LC-MS/MS on an LTQ-Orbitrap mass spectrometer... analyzed via LC-MS/MS on an LTQ-Velos-Orbitrap mass spectrometer
labeling: Total spectral counts (TSC) were used to approximate each site’s abundance within each tissue.
